body.name: Hrank
body.def: For the multiplication map \(m_{\zeta,S}:C_d(S)\to\bigl(A_d(S)+\zeta_{\ell}C_d(S)\bigr)/A_d(S)\), \(c\mapsto\zeta_{\ell}c+A_d(S)\), let \(\mathfrak H_{\ell,d}(S)\) be the sum of squares of all \(\dim C_d(S)\)-square minors of a rational matrix for \(m_{\zeta,S}\); it is nonzero exactly when multiplication by \(\zeta_{\ell}\) is injective modulo \(A_d(S)\), equivalently when no degree-\(d\) certificate can adjoin \(\zeta_{\ell}\) after \(S\).
